packageRules.description: The Python interpreter moves .python-version, docker/Dockerfile and the CI matrix together, and a new minor needs cp3XX wheels for every pin in uv.lock (see #281: eight transitive packages had none). Minor bumps of python therefore wait for a human even though :automergeMinor would take them; patch releases still automerge. Listed after the presets on purpose: the last matching rule wins. Both names are needed: matchPackageNames compares packageName, which is `python` for the docker image but `actions/python-versions` for the setup-python `python-version` input; the short name alone left the CI side automerging (verified with renovate's rule engine).
